name: EPIC 246233006
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 12, 7.9 solar radii and 0.92 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 246233006 (K2 campaign 12): PARAM radius (solar radii) 7.913505 (16th-84th percentiles 7.652014-8.221775), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 246233006: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4681.044 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 246233006 (K2 campaign 12): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3142.226562 (16th-84th percentiles 3047.460938-3243.007812), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,142 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 0.92 solar masses and 7.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,681 K at its surface.
